{{Quote|I'll show them after the speech.|Unidentified technician after being [[Mind trick/Legends|Mind tricked]] by [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]|<ref name="TDoR" />}}
This '''unidentified technician''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Telos IV]]. Sometime in [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], the [[Technician/Legends|technician]] was in charge of transmitting images of Telox IV as stage background whenever former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Xanatos]] was giving prizes to the [[Katharsis]] winners. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] in [[Mind trick/Legends|convincing]] the technician to show images that Xanatos' company, [[Offworld Mining Corporation]], was stripping their planet of its resources.<ref name="TDoR" />

The technician was fond of eating [[meat pie]]s even while working, which covered all his fingers in grease.<ref name="TDoR" />
